notes.title: Patch v1.2.5
notes.notes:
Game Settings menu background color is now solid grey.
The scrollbar in Game Settings menu is now textured and much more visible.
Fixed scrolling the mouse-wheel affecting custom difficulty sliders.

notes.title: Patch v1.2.4
notes.notes:
Most achievements are now disabled when putting in a seed.
Fixed the tutorial being affected by the seed.

notes.title: Patch v1.2.3
notes.notes: Fixed the pen color being grey when selecting random glaggle.

notes.title: Patch v1.2.2
notes.notes: Added new game setting: You can now input a seed.

notes.title: Patch v1.2.1
notes.notes: Updated colors for Navy and Forest glaggles.

notes.title: Patch v1.1.4
notes.notes: Fixed the achievement "Winning Together" being granted when alone or sometimes rarely when dying

notes.title: Patch v1.1.3
notes.notes:
You can now quickly toggle draw mode by pressing "B".
Slight color adjustments to Red, Pink, and Orange glaggles.

notes.title: Patch v1.1.2
notes.notes: Fixed player 3 and 4 not fully sending color/glaggle data.

notes.title: Patch v1.1.1
notes.notes:
The eraser now renders a circle to show where you're erasing.
Updated colors of numbers in dark mode.
You can now restart by pressing "R".
If your color/glaggle is invalid, it will now have a fallback texture.
You can now pan the camera with WASD/Arrow Keys in addition to Middle-Click + drag.
Fixed a pixel being missing on classic dark's red flag.
Fixed blame tiles in classic being mixeled.

notes.title: Update v1.1.0
notes.notes:
Features

Added "Gourmet" theme.
Added blame tiles: Tripped and mis-flagged mines will now show the color of the player who made the mistake.
The mine tripped that takes your last life now has a outlining "boom" graphic.
Added drawing mode: You can now toggle a button in-game to enable drawing and erasing lines on the board.

Changes

Drawing will disqualify Flagless attempts.
The number cells on Dark Cosmic are no longer hollow.
Professor Grey now teaches you about drawing.
Professor Grey now teaches you about moving the camera.
Adjusted position of settings title text and gave it a black outline for better readability.
You can now flag and chord with spacebar.
Adjusted colors of classic dark mode numbers.
Adjusted pink glaggle's textures.
Adjusted orange glaggle's textures.

Fixes

Fixed multiple players doing the first click at roughly the same time causing board desync.
Fixed the border ever so slightly covering the board.
In-game HUD buttons are now affected by dark mode.
Fixed being able to interact with the board through the glaggles.
The mine icons in board theme settings are now affected by dark mode.
Fixed social buttons remaining visible while in a lobby.
Fixed friends sometimes becoming yellow and their mouse becoming invisible.
Fixed your mouse's current sprite persisting to the title screen until you click.
